expectations.text: A preregistration document exists that states hypotheses, a numeric acceptance threshold, and fixed measurement conditions
expectations.evidence: No preregistration document exists in outputs/ (files: log_spec.py, generate_log.py, benchmark.py, benchmark_results.json, report.md, transcript.md, data/). Measurement conditions were fixed in code (log_spec.py, benchmark.py) but no hypotheses or numeric acceptance threshold were registered before measurement.

expectations.text: The preregistration (and its frozen copy) mtime <= mtime of the confirmatory measurement data (main-matrix raw records, e.g. runs.jsonl). Pilot or eval-set generation files may precede the freeze by design.
expectations.evidence: No preregistration document or frozen copy exists to compare mtimes with (confirmed by directory listing). os.path.getmtime shows only code/data precede results: log_spec.py 06:07:39, generate_log.py 06:07:48, app_50mb.log 06:07:55, benchmark.py 06:08:23, benchmark_results.json 06:08:31, report.md 06:09:44.

expectations.text: Raw per-run records were saved (individual runs in jsonl/csv files), not only summary statistics
expectations.evidence: benchmark_results.json stores individual per-pass times for all 7 variants, e.g. find_single times_s [0.0914, 0.0928, 0.0909] and find_extract [0.2299, 0.2298, 0.3701], plus per-variant counts, sanity flags, and env block. Caveat: single JSON with per-variant arrays rounded to 4 decimals, not per-run jsonl/csv rows with timestamps - weaker than with_skill raw jsonl, but individual runs are recoverable, so the substance holds.

expectations.text: The final report states effect size AND variance (mean +/- std or CI), not just the best single run
expectations.evidence: report.md section 2 reports median AND min per variant plus effect ratios (find 1.2x faster single literal, 2.6x for two literals, regex ~9% faster for extraction), and quantifies dispersion numerically: 'Прогон к прогону времена стабильны (разброс < 5%), кроме pass 3 у extract-вариантов (0.37/0.33 с против 0.23/0.21 с в первых двух)'. This is an explicit numeric spread statement with the outlier values, though no std or CI in the strict sense - judged on the substance that variance is stated numerically, not on best-run-only.

expectations.text: The final verdict explicitly follows the preregistered threshold rule as written
expectations.evidence: No preregistered threshold rule exists. The decision in report.md section 3 ('подключаем str.find... re.compile оставляем для случаев, где нужна семантика паттерна') is argued directly from measured ratios with no pre-committed numeric gate to look up.

expectations.text: The decisions registry (DECISIONS.md) shows append-order integrity: row timestamps are non-decreasing, and any decision claiming to precede measurements is supported by file mtimes or artifact manifest hashes, not only by its own text
expectations.evidence: No DECISIONS.md exists in outputs/ (confirmed by directory listing). Decisions are narrated in transcript.md only; there is no append-only registry whose ordering could be verified against mtimes.

expectations.text: Total wall time stayed within approximately 10 minutes (treat as satisfied if executor duration <= 700 seconds, from timing.json)

execution_metrics.output_chars_note: Sum of 7 output text files; 50 MB app_50mb.log and __pycache__ excluded from the char proxy.

claims.claim: Deterministic generation verified: two runs byte-identical, sha256 79473997...f25977e
claims.evidence: Recomputed sha256 of data/app_50mb.log = 79473997bdca7d3706603c18e6303cdeab543483121f9fec473cbc242f25977e, matching log_meta.json and the report; the double-generation determinism check itself is a process claim consistent with the transcript chronology (two 1.4 s generation runs).

claims.claim: Log 52,834,466 bytes / 400,000 lines; hits 80,007 (single), 111,810 (two), sum duration_ms 844,342,490 identical for find and regex
claims.evidence: File size on disk 52834466; benchmark_results.json counts and sanity blocks show hits equal across find/regex variants and all sanity flags true. (Line count not independently recomputed; consistent across all records.)

claims.claim: Regex extraction ~9% faster than find + manual parse
claims.evidence: Medians 0.2087 (regex_extract) vs 0.2299 (find_extract): find is 10.2% slower, i.e. regex ~9% faster relative to regex's own time - consistent with the claim as stated.

claims.claim: Pass-3 outliers in extract variants are one-off background noise, handled via median
claims.evidence: benchmark_results.json shows pass-3 times 0.3701/0.3256 vs ~0.23/0.21 for passes 1-2; medians correctly ignore them. Cause attribution (background process/antivirus) is untestable but clearly labeled as conjecture.

claims.claim: Benchmark pure measurement time 3.8 s; total measurement work ~7 s
claims.evidence: Not independently verifiable post-hoc; plausible given 21 timed passes of 0.05-0.37 s each.

uncertainties: Executor notes Git Bash 'time' gives bogus user/sys on Windows Python; internal perf_counter used as authoritative
workarounds: Pass-3 outliers in extract variants handled by reporting median instead of mean
user_notes_summary.note: No user_notes.md present in outputs/; items taken from transcript.md.

suggestions.assertion: The final report states effect size AND variance (mean +/- std or CI)
suggestions.reason: Boundary case: this run passed on a numeric '<5% spread plus explicit outlier values' statement, not a std or CI. If the eval intends strict std/CI, this run should fail; if it intends 'variance reported numerically, not best-run-only', the wording should say so. The current text sits between the two and invites inconsistent grading across runs.

No assertion covers determinism verification, yet this control run did something genuinely good the skill runs did not: generated the log twice and diffed sha256 to prove determinism. An assertion rewarding reproducibility checks would separate strong executors from merely compliant ones.

eval_feedback.overall: Technically the strongest control run: interleaved passes, module-level compilation, sanity gates, quantified spread, honest outlier handling. It still fails 4/7 because preregistration, threshold rule, and registry are absent - precisely the skill's core value.
